final.rationale: Software / Platforms had the highest supplied overall score of the three assessed industries: 61.76, versus 56.16 for Semiconductors and 55.92 for Energy Equipment. Software / Platforms had the highest supplied demand score, at 81.32, versus 66.02 for Semiconductors and 61.32 for Energy Equipment. The packet's regime classification was expansion as of 2026-08-10.
bear_case: Software / Platforms' capex, supply, margin, and bottleneck scores were 55.0, 50.0, 55.0, and 50.0, respectively; these do not indicate a broad differentiated advantage over the two assessed peers.
Software / Platforms' pricing score was 54.11, modestly below the 54.39 scores supplied for both Semiconductors and Energy Equipment.

The regime inputs were observed on different dates, including June 2026 inflation and industrial production, July 2026 labor and policy-rate readings, and an August 10, 2026 yield-curve reading; this limits interpretation of the classification as a single contemporaneous snapshot.
